domain: C: canonical finite folded decimal words
bad_set: B: words whose first positive ordinary reverse-add output is a palindrome
modes: Any specified set M; finiteness is optional for soundness
mode_languages: One exact semantic subset L_m of C for each m in M

obligations.name: nonempty
obligations.quantifier: exists m0 in M, exists w0 in C, w0 in L_m0
obligations.evidence: Concrete word, mode, and exact membership proof

obligations.name: universal_safety
obligations.quantifier: forall m in M, forall w in L_m, w not in B
obligations.evidence: Complete inclusion or disjointness certificate over all words

obligations.name: universal_successor_coverage
obligations.quantifier: forall m in M, forall w in L_m, exists m_next in M, G(w) in L_m_next
obligations.evidence: Complete transition inclusion; mode choice may depend on the entire word and current mode

consequence: The union of all L_m is nonempty, safe, and forward closed
projection_condition: Every L_m is saturated under the same fixed complete configuration equivalence
projection_consequence: The union is saturated under that same equivalence; adaptive switching cannot rescue any class containing a terminating representative
finite_repair_result: Every language with finite symmetric difference from F10 fails successor coverage
selected_inverse_result: No word in that cylinder has a two-step predecessor
remaining_gap: No exact semantic language satisfying all three obligations has been supplied
